children: Alkermes appointed Anne C. Whitaker to its board, increasing the board size to eleven directors with her initial term expiring at the 2027 annual general meeting.
Board increased size from ten to eleven directors; appointment to fill new seat
Not disclosed beyond appointment; initial term expires at 2027 annual general meeting
As of report date, not appointed to any committee

Entitled to annual cash retainer and annual equity grant per company policy; initial new director equity award target value $600,000 (50% stock options, 50% RSUs) vesting in three equal annual installments; award expected October 2026; option exercise price = closing Nasdaq price on grant date
Company and a wholly-owned subsidiary entered into indemnification agreements in forms previously filed (Exhibits referenced)
